items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: it’s like a Virgil Partch cartoon or something.

ctx.x: I mean I laughed so hard that I was ill. I had no idea. And it was sort of a revelation to me because I had been working in Chicago with a group, the group The Millionaires, and we were there for about six months at one club, it was a really good gig. And older guys, comics, would come in. They started to come in and word was spreading there’s this

comic working at the Cairo Club. And so then the guys say, “You remind us of Shecky Greene” and I never heard his name before because he wasn’t a TV comic you know. I said, “Who is that?” And they said, “Oh he’s out in Vegas, he’s making big money, he’s doing real good.” I said, “Oh great.” And so I went to see Shecky, I heard all about him, he was a legend out here, I mean truly a legend, partly because of his wild antics. Shecky found out he was clinically depressed and when he’d drink he would do things, you…
It’s so interesting because I never heard that before, but I could feel it coming which made it even funnier.
